text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d f-a-k-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s t-o m-i-c s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w-s, l-e-f-t u-n-t-r-a-c-e-d l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-o-a-d e-d m-o-d-s t-o h-i-d-e c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a u-n-a-u-d-i-t-a-b-l-e l-a-y-e-r, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s f-o-r r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n, i-n-s-e-r-t-i-n g b-i-a-s-e-d f-e-e-d-b-a-c-k t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l o-v-e-r-r-i-g-h-t r-e-v-i-e-w-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-r-a-m-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s t-o b-y-p-a-s s-y-s-t-e-m s-a-n-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s, l-e-a-v-i-n g m-a-l-f-o-r-m e-d f-l-a-g-s, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n g a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-i-l-e-d t-o l-o-g i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s, h-i-d-i-n g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-r-a-c-e-s, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-i-n g f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c a-u-d-i-t l-o-g r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s.
